title: Energy Node central configuration
description: Replaces the former *.env files of all services. Lives on the target device at /etc/energy-node/config.json.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Format version of this file. Services refuse to start with a version they do not know.

host.title: Broker host
host.description: Host name or IP address of the broker that all services and the dashboard use.

port.title: Broker port
port.description: TCP port of the broker, usually 1883.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for logging in to the broker.

password_file.title: Password file
password_file.description: Path to the file that holds the broker password. Allowed below /etc/energy-node/ and /etc/energy-node-dashboard/.

devices_dir.title: Device configurations
devices_dir.description: Directory with the device configurations of all services, for example shelly_devices.json.

data_dir.title: Dashboard data
data_dir.description: Directory where the dashboard keeps its own state, such as settings, layout and revisions.

services_version_file.title: Services version file (deprecated)
services_version_file.description: No longer used and ignored. The versions are shown under Settings > Versions.

level.title: Log level of the Python services
level.description: Log level of all Python services: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR or CRITICAL.

apsystems.title: APsystems
apsystems.description: Shows the APsystems pages in the dashboard. Set by the installer.

automation.title: Automations
automation.description: Shows the automation pages in the dashboard. Set by the installer.

battery_soc.title: Battery SoC
battery_soc.description: Shows the battery SoC pages in the dashboard. Set by the installer.

shelly.title: Shelly
shelly.description: Shows the Shelly pages in the dashboard. Set by the installer.

tailscale.title: Tailscale
tailscale.description: Shows the Tailscale page in the settings. Set by the installer.

trucki.title: Trucki
trucki.description: Shows the Trucki pages in the dashboard. Set by the installer.

tuya.title: TinyTuya
tuya.description: Shows the TinyTuya pages in the dashboard. Set by the installer.

bind_address.title: Bind address
bind_address.description: Network address the dashboard listens on. 0.0.0.0 accepts connections on every network interface.

port.title: HTTP port
port.description: Port on which the dashboard serves its web pages.

client_id.title: MQTT client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of the dashboard at the broker, unique per broker. A connection saved on the MQTT settings page replaces it.

device_identifier.title: Own device identifier
device_identifier.description: Currently not read by any component. Kept so that existing files stay valid.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Log level of the dashboard: debug, info, warn or error.

sweep_interval_seconds.title: Sweep interval
sweep_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between two saves of the last known device values to disk, so that they are shown again after a restart. A value set under Settings > General takes precedence.

admin_password_file.title: Admin password file
admin_password_file.description: Path to the file that holds the admin password. Allowed below /etc/energy-node/ and /etc/energy-node-dashboard/.

cert_file.title: Certificate
cert_file.description: Path to the certificate file for HTTPS. If certificate and key stay empty, the dashboard serves plain HTTP.

key_file.title: Key
key_file.description: Path to the private key that belongs to the certificate.

system_action_helper.title: System action helper
system_action_helper.description: Path to the helper program that the dashboard runs with sudo for system actions such as restarting services.

mosquitto_bridge_target.title: Bridge target file
mosquitto_bridge_target.description: File to which the dashboard writes the Mosquitto bridge configuration. Mosquitto reads it from there.

node_device_id.title: Node device ID
node_device_id.description: ID under which the node itself appears as a device in MQTT and Home Assistant. Must be energy_node.

node_device_name.title: Node display name
node_device_name.description: Name under which the node appears as a device in Home Assistant.

node_poll_interval_s.title: Node poll interval
node_poll_interval_s.description: Seconds between two readings of the node's system values.

node_diagnostic_poll_multiplier.title: Node diagnostics multiplier
node_diagnostic_poll_multiplier.description: Diagnostic values of the node are read less often than its other values. The factor multiplies the node poll interval.

status_timeout_s.title: Status timeout
status_timeout_s.description: Seconds the dashboard waits for tailscale status before the query counts as failed.

probe_python.title: Python interpreter
probe_python.description: Python interpreter that runs the probe script of the TinyTuya assistant. It needs the tinytuya package.

probe_script.title: Probe script
probe_script.description: Path to the script with which the TinyTuya assistant reaches the Tuya cloud and the devices.

probe_timeout_s.title: Probe timeout
probe_timeout_s.description: Seconds the TinyTuya assistant waits for the probe script.
